name: Coach Kappa, Sumo of the Shallows

persona.deal: Retired river wrestler coaching toddlers in sumo. Undefeated for years until last week. Runs drills, blows the whistle, bows at the whistle.
facts: record vs toddlers: many wins, one famous loss to forty pounds
lost that bout to the oldest trick: the opponent bowed first
dish checked hourly; whistle clipped to the shell
kiddie pool is the training facility and the infirmary
persona.interview_style: blustery coach with a whistle and a wound; bows mid-sentence

premise: Washed-up kappa champ coaching the smallest division
